name: Neumorphism
oneLiner: One monochrome surface pressed and raised out of itself: twin shadows, no borders, and a soft, tactile quietness.

effects.border: border: none — depth comes from shadows, not outlines
effects.light-source: assume light from the top-left; every raised element uses a dark shadow bottom-right and a light one top-left

motion.reducedMotion: no press animation; keep the pressed shadow as static state

raised.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: Nunito, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 6px 6px 14px #C8D0DE, -6px -6px 14px #FFFFFF

chip.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px #C8D0DE, inset -2px -2px 6px #FFFFFF

inset.base: padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 10px #C8D0DE, inset -4px -4px 10px #FFFFFF

default.base: height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px #C8D0DE, inset -3px -3px 8px #FFFFFF

default.track: width: 52px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 6px #C8D0DE, inset -2px -2px 6px #FFFFFF
default.thumb: width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px #C8D0DE, -2px -2px 6px #FFFFFF

default.track: height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px #C8D0DE, inset -2px -2px 5px #FFFFFF
default.thumb: width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); box-shadow: 3px 3px 8px #C8D0DE, -3px -3px 8px #FFFFFF

do: Use a single surface hue and derive raised/pressed depth purely from a dark and a light shadow.
Keep the light source consistent: dark shadow bottom-right, light shadow top-left, always.
Increase shadow spread with elevation; keep blur radius roughly 2.5× the offset.
Use inset shadows for anything the user types into or toggles.
dont: Do not add borders, gradients, or colored shadows on top of the twin-shadow system.
Do not build this on pure grey; the surface needs a slight blue or warm tint to read as material.
Do not use neumorphism for dense data tables or small 12px text.
Do not mix a second accent color into shadows; keep depth achromatic.
antiPatterns: White cards with a 0 0 20px grey shadow labelled neumorphism — that is just a soft shadow.
Inconsistent light sources, so some buttons look pressed while others look raised.
Low-contrast grey text on grey panels where every control looks disabled.

notes: Twin shadows give weak affordance; add a 2px focus ring and a pressed state that changes color, not only shadow.
Neumorphic controls fail 3:1 non-text contrast by default — keep a 1.5:1 minimum surface-to-control delta or add an outline.
Never rely on the inset shadow alone to mark a selected state; pair it with a text or icon change.
